$description: The audio signature that runs under the split intro. It takes its hit and its length from brand/tokens/motion.json, so picture and sound cannot drift apart. Times in seconds, levels in dB. Every number has an entry in brand/tokens/provenance.json.

seed.$description: Seed for every noise source, so a build sounds the same every time.

start.$description: The noise riser starts; it ends on the hit.

mix.$description: Share of reverb in the mix.

start.$description: The wave under the type swells in.

from.$description: Centre of its noise band at rest, Hz.

to.$description: Centre of its noise band at the crest, Hz.

below.$description: Its level against the tail, measured over 3.3 to 4.3 s.

fade.$description: The sound fades out here, earlier than the picture: the lockup holds longer than the sound needs to.

drive.$description: tanh saturation before the peak is set.
